stem: When Max shows his father the time capsule he dug up, Max’s father most likely feels —

options.label: F
options.text: amazed that Max found it when he could not

options.label: G
options.text: pleased to see things that were once meaningful to him

options.label: H
options.text: upset that Max is no longer helping Grandpa plant a tree

options.label: J
options.text: concerned about what Max will think when he sees what is in the can
